grain_rationale: row_count is 13014 and duplicate_row_rate is 0.0, with 3 distinct airport_code values and 4341 distinct observed_hour_utc values (3*4341=13023, close to 13014, implying a handful of airport-hour combinations are simply absent rather than duplicated); no single column is unique on its own (no distinct_count equals row_count), so a composite transaction identity over (airport_code, observed_hour_utc) is proposed; since duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 the identity tuple already absorbs all rows without collision, so no aggregation is needed.

fields.name: airport_code
fields.description: Three-letter airport code (EWR, JFK, LGA per distinct_values) identifying which airport the observation belongs to; null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: observed_hour_utc
fields.description: UTC timestamp of the hourly weather observation, sampled at exact hour boundaries (e.g. 2013-01-01T06:00:00) with 4341 distinct values; null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: observed_date_local
fields.description: Local calendar date of the observation (e.g. 2013-01-01), 181 distinct values spanning the six-month history; null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: observed_hour_local
fields.description: Local hour-of-day (0-23) label for the observation, 24 distinct values; a categorical hour marker rather than a summable measure; null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: temp_f
fields.description: Air temperature in Fahrenheit ranging 10.94 to 93.92, a continuous measure compared and aggregated across observations; null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: dewpoint_f
fields.description: Dew point temperature in Fahrenheit ranging -9.94 to 73.94, a continuous measure; null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: humidity_pct
fields.description: Relative humidity percentage ranging 12.74 to 100.0 with 2178 distinct values, a continuous measure; null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: wind_dir_degrees
fields.description: Wind direction in compass degrees (0-360, 37 distinct values), a directional label rather than a summable quantity; nullable with null_rate 0.016828, likely reflecting calm-wind readings with no defined direction.

fields.name: wind_speed_mph
fields.description: Wind speed in miles per hour ranging 0.0 to 1048.36058, a continuous measure; nullable with null_rate 0.000154.

fields.name: wind_gust_mph
fields.description: Wind gust speed in miles per hour ranging 16.11092 to 62.14212, a continuous measure recorded only when gusts occur; nullable with null_rate 0.745505, reflecting that most observed hours have no gust.

fields.name: precip_inches
fields.description: Precipitation in inches ranging 0.0 to 1.06, a continuous measure; null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: pressure_mb
fields.description: Barometric pressure in millibars ranging 983.8 to 1038.4, a continuous measure; nullable with null_rate 0.114953.

fields.name: visibility_miles
fields.description: Visibility in miles, a capped set of 20 distinct values from 0.0 to 10.0, a continuous measure; null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: airport_name
fields.description: Full airport name (e.g. John F. Kennedy International Airport), 3 distinct values matching airport_code; null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: airport_municipality
fields.description: Municipality hosting the airport (New York or Newark), 2 distinct values; null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: airport_elevation_ft
fields.description: Airport elevation in feet (13, 18, or 21), a static attribute of the airport rather than a measured event quantity; null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: airport_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Longest runway length in feet for the airport (7002, 11000, or 14511), a static airport attribute; null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: captured_at
fields.description: Pipeline capture timestamp recorded at ingestion (e.g. 2026-09-02T23:26:11), distinct from the observation's own event time and not used as the event timestamp; null_rate 0.0.

category_description: Each row represents one hourly weather observation recorded at a specific airport, capturing atmospheric conditions such as temperature, humidity, wind, precipitation, pressure, and visibility for that airport and hour.
purpose: This mapping declares how the silver_airport_weather table enters the gold unified event star as the airport_weather_observations fact category, documenting the source table, grain, time column, and the role and type of every column for the deterministic modeling engine that generates the gold models.
usage: The modeling engine consumes this mapping contract, rendered to the ODCS mapping contract draft and validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema and datacontract lint, before a human reviews and approves it; downstream consumers then query the generated fact for airport-hour weather analysis.
limitations: The mapping does not filter or flag rows with missing wind_gust_mph (null_rate 0.745505), pressure_mb (null_rate 0.114953), wind_dir_degrees (null_rate 0.016828), or wind_speed_mph (null_rate 0.000154); consumers must handle these nulls themselves, and no quality rule, transformation, or derived column beyond the composite (airport_code, observed_hour_utc) identity is proposed.
